overview: This course studies LLM-based AI agents: systems that use large language models to perceive, reason, plan, and act over many steps. Agents interact with their environments — calling tools, navigating interfaces, writing code, working alongside people — to complete real tasks.

The course covers both the foundations of building agents and active research questions around long-horizon reasoning, training, safety, and interaction. We emphasize hands-on implementation with modern frameworks and the training methods that make agents more capable and reliable.
course.audience: Graduate students with prior experience training neural language models. Relevant background includes coursework such as 11-667, 11-711, or 10-202, or equivalent experience.

logistics.label: Academic breaks
logistics.value: Fall Break: Oct. 12 – 16 · Thanksgiving Break: Nov. 25 – 27

themes.title: Agent Capabilities
themes.topics: Instruction following, tool use, planning, and memory systems.

themes.title: Application Domains
themes.topics: General tool use, coding agents, GUI agents, and social agents.

themes.title: Training Methods
themes.topics: Supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning algorithms and systems.

themes.title: Frameworks
themes.topics: OpenHands, LangGraph, and other agent development frameworks.

themes.title: Safety
themes.topics: Sandboxing, credentialing, and adversarial attacks on agents.

themes.title: Advanced Topics
themes.topics: Human-agent interaction, multi-agent systems, and search-based reasoning.

learning_objectives: Implement an agent from scratch on top of an open-source LLM.
Train agents to improve their capabilities.
Reason about safety and reliability tradeoffs.
Pursue an open research question in agents.

assignments.title: Assignment 1 · Harness
assignments.summary: Build the harness infrastructure for a coding agent on top of an open-source LLM.

assignments.title: Assignment 2 · Eval
assignments.summary: Design the evaluation framework needed to measure agent correctness and functionality.

assignments.title: Assignment 3 · Training
assignments.summary: Implement the training procedures used to adapt and improve the agent.

assignments.title: Half-semester research project
assignments.summary: Teams of 2–4 explore an advanced topic in LLM agents and produce a proposal, check-in, poster presentation, and final report.
